avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce hepatic enzymes and potentially reduce degarelix efficacy through altered metabolism
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Degarelix may affect bone mineral density; high-dose calcium supplementation requires monitoring to assess therapeutic benefit
caution_supplements.action: Monitor bone health markers; discuss supplementation timing with healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Degarelix-induced hypogonadism increases osteoporosis risk; vitamin D supports bone health management
caution_supplements.action: Consider supplementation as part of bone protection strategy; monitor 25-OH vitamin D levels

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay subcutaneous absorption of degarelix; unlikely to significantly impact efficacy
caution_foods.action: No dietary restrictions needed; maintain consistent meal patterns

monitoring_notes: Degarelix has minimal drug-drug interactions due to lack of CYP metabolism and protein binding. Monitor testosterone suppression efficacy, PSA levels, bone mineral density, and QT interval (risk of prolongation); counsel patients on hot flashes and injection site reactions.
